findings.claim: MessagePack attributes on the formatted type are ignored. Collection always chooses contractless members unless a surrogate is supplied, so a type carrying [MessagePackObject] and integer [Key] annotations still receives name-based string keys, contrary to the acceptance criterion that those attributes be honoured.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generated-formatter execution test for a type declared with [MessagePackObject], a member [Key(0)], and another member [IgnoreMember], without setting SurrogateType. Serialize it and assert the existing MessagePack integer-key array contract and ignored membership; the current collector instead produces contractless string keys.

findings.claim: Contractless field selection is inverted: public mutable fields are excluded while public readonly fields are included and marked readable/writable. Consequently ordinary public fields are not serialized, and a readonly field can make generated deserialization invalid by assigning to it.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an external class with a public mutable field and a public readonly field, generate its contractless formatter, and round-trip the mutable field. The test should also require successful compilation of the generated formatter; the current field predicate fails these expectations.

findings.claim: The existing policy against implicitly analyzing or generating formatters for metadata-only types remains deliberate; this feature is a separate explicit opt-in through [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter], so the new path is consistent with that policy.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] records that referenced-assembly types ordinarily receive no analysis or formatter from the compiling assembly. The new attribute-driven request is explicitly declared in the consuming assembly and therefore does not change that default behaviour.
